Trace, implement and test: 10.10.Rank from Stream

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class BinaryIndexedTree {
private:
    int n;
    vector<int> c;

public:
    BinaryIndexedTree(int n)
        : n(n)
        , c(n + 1) {}

    void update(int x, int delta) {
        for (; x <= n; x += x & -x) {
            c[x] += delta;
        }
    }

    int query(int x) {
        int s = 0;
        for (; x > 0; x -= x & -x) {
            s += c[x];
        }
        return s;
    }
};

class StreamRank {
public:
    StreamRank() {
    }

    void track(int x) {
        tree->update(x + 1, 1);
    }

    int getRankOfNumber(int x) {
        return tree->query(x + 1);
    }

private:
    BinaryIndexedTree* tree = new BinaryIndexedTree(50010);
};

/**
 * Your StreamRank object will be instantiated and called as such:
 * StreamRank* obj = new StreamRank();
 * obj->track(x);
 * int param_2 = obj->getRankOfNumber(x);
 */
